basic_info.description: Lower, spacious bi-level unit in 2 unit building. Main level has nicely sized open kitchen w/maple cabinets, half-bath & an open dining/living room with built-in cabinets, wet-bar & corner gas fireplace. The LR + DR also feature sliding glass doors opening onto a nice deck. Lower level has 2 bedrooms, each with a private bathroom + wonderful closet & storage space. One of the master suites also enjoys direct access to a 2nd deck overlooking the lush greenery of Glen Canyon Park. Large garage with s/s parking + laundry + storage. Walk to Glen Park village eateries, grocery shopping, Bart, the #44 Muni bus, corp shuttles & Glen Park Canyon! Seller looking for one offer on the building. Suggested TIC pricing for partners wanting both units.
